description: Simple and rapid application development framework, built on top of Flask. includes detailed security, auto CRUD generation for your models, google charts and much more. Demo (login with guest/welcome) - http://flaskappbuilder.pythonanywhere.com/

## What's Changed

* release: 5.3.0 by @dpgaspar in https://github.com/dpgaspar/Flask-AppBuilder/pull/2489


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dpgaspar/Flask-AppBuilder/compare/v5.2.3...v5.3.0
